value.summary: Extended tests/calc.test.mjs (existing "arithmetic" test untouched) with: spaces ignored (" 2 + 3 * 4 " → 14), parentheses overriding precedence ("(2+3)*4" → 20) and nesting ("2*(3+(4-1))" → 12), left-associative subtraction ("10-4-3" → 3), true division ("7/2" → 3.5), unary minus ("-(2+3)*4" → -20), throws on invalid input ("2+", "foo", "(2+3", "2 3"), and a static source check reading lib/calc.mjs and asserting it contains neither forbidden API name — executable evidence for the security constraint. Only tests/calc.test.mjs was modified, per the declared write target.

evidenceCandidates.statement: Tests now cover all four operators, precedence, parentheses, spaces, and error handling for the parser.
The static source check asserts lib/calc.mjs contains neither forbidden API name, complementing the SEC-C01-A notContains file acceptance.
